title: Document check, version 1
description: Extension point doccheck: what iVendNext sends a partner's HTTPS service before a back-office document a shop named is submitted, or saved as a draft where the subscription asks (request), what the service answers (answer, judged whole by business_logic/partner_doccheck.py validate_answer: one bad key or value refuses the whole answer, and the declared down answer applies), and the settings a System Manager saves on the subscription (settings). Never a till sale, its day's opening, the day close or its merge. Page: docs/extending/doccheck.md.

event.description: submit: the document is being submitted. validate: a draft is being saved (only where the settings ask).

company.description: The record's company, or null on a record type that has none.

user.description: The login of the user submitting (usually an email address).

fields.description: Exactly the settings' send_fields: money as {minor, currency, currency_exponent}, a quantity in thousandths, a table as a list of rows. null when a field could no longer be sent (the service is then not asked).

answer.description: HTTP 2xx, a JSON object of at most 64 KB, one of five.

reason.description: Shown to the user as the reason the document is not submitted.

question.description: Shown to the user; a yes submits. An import or API call with no yes is refused with it.

role.description: A role on this site (never Guest, All or Administrator). A user holding it confirms; anyone else is refused.

fields.description: 1 to 10 of the settings' fill_fields, each a value of its field's type.

record_type.description: One submittable record type: not a table, a single or a virtual one, and not POS Invoice, POS Opening Entry, POS Closing Entry or POS Invoice Merge Log.

send_fields.description: The Desk action's grammar: name, customer, items(item_code, qty) — at most 40 fields and 5 tables.

on_validate.description: true: a draft's save is checked too. Not on Sales Order, Sales Invoice, Delivery Note, Payment Entry or Journal Entry (the till's booking inserts them).

fill_fields.description: Fields an answer may fill: only fields the shop added itself (a custom field), each one a user fills in, never Currency or a name a total is computed from.
